title: Executable-wiring must ignore gitignored nested worktrees and scan only canonical repository files

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Substantive implementation commit. Post-merge closeout automation rebinds this field to the authoritative merge SHA.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence; this is not PM approval or independent certification.

focused_tests.detail: Includes five UTV2-1659 regressions for nested worktrees, tracked .claude documentation, ignored/untracked invariance, newly tracked debt enforcement, and clean-clone/worktree-heavy parity.

canonical_scan.detail: The same checkout previously reported 3,321 tests and 2,856 false new findings from nested local worktrees.

verify_static.detail: Environment validation, alignment, automation coverage, lint, type-check, build, aggregate tests, Smart Form verification, and command checks passed.

pnpm_verify.detail: All static checks passed; the final local test:live-db stage correctly refused the loopback target. T1 staging DB proof must be harvested from the governed PR CI environment.

runtime_proof.classification: Governance tooling only; no production runtime, database, deployment, secret, branch-protection, or worktree mutation is part of this lane.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: A git-backed fixture adds an ignored nested repository containing a test-shaped file; canonical totals remain zero with no findings.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Tracked .claude policy and command files remain scanned.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Tracked policy and command Markdown files remain in listRepoFiles('.claude') and appear as documentation references.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Ignored or untracked files cannot affect totals.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Canonical totals, test entries, and findings remain byte-equivalent after ignored and untracked test-shaped files are added.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Newly tracked unwired files still fail.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: A staged test file produces WIRING_TEST_UNWIRED_NEW and a FAIL verdict.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Clean-clone and worktree-heavy checkout results are identical.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Totals, tests, capabilities, findings, and parser errors are identical before and after sixteen local worktree-residue files are created.

known_limitations: The mandatory T1 staging DB proof and full pnpm verify verdict remain pending until the governed PR CI run completes.
